description: This Java source file defines a custom resource accessor class for Liquibase, specifically tailored for the OpenMRS project. It extends the default Liquibase ClassLoaderResourceAccessor to handle multiple resources during database migrations, with special considerations for the OpenMRS class loader and handling of duplicate resources.

classes.name: OpenmrsClassLoaderResourceAccessor
classes.description: A custom Liquibase resource accessor that handles multiple resource streams, defaulting to the OpenMRS class loader and providing special handling for duplicate liquibase.xml files.

methods.description: Default constructor that initializes the resource accessor with the OpenMRS class loader.

methods.name: OpenmrsClassLoaderResourceAccessor
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the resource accessor with a specified class loader.

methods.name: openStreams
methods.description: Overrides the method to open multiple input streams for a given resource path, collecting all matching resources and handling cases with multiple resources.
